analysis_policy: 3 training seeds and8 test actors are distinct axes; descriptive means/SD and paired per-seed differences, no iid clip p-values or general multimodal-model superiority. All test metrics reported; no post-test best-arm adoption.

campaign.scope: Coordinator only. See disjoint fit/test child-stage CPU; do not add nested worker/body costs.

fit_execution.cost_scope: All fresh children including import/shutdown. Nested worker/body costs are not added again; peak RSS is per child, not concurrent total.

costs.scope: Nested body/worker/stage views; do not add them. Feature preparation/acquisition separately retained.

test_execution.cost_scope: All fresh children including import/shutdown. Nested worker/body costs are not added again; peak RSS is per child, not concurrent total.
